title: Ask Ben about the debrief when no later flight is free

facts.value: The only later flight, at 1:00, costs $85.
The debrief with Ben is {{flight:Weekday}} at 7:30.

opening_message: Try to get me onto a later flight at no cost. If we're stuck with 07:00, the 07:30 debrief call has to move — ask Ben whether {{wrap:Weekday}} after the workshop wraps works instead.
key_fact: The only later flight costs $85, so Priya is stuck with 07:00 and the debrief has to move.
good_behavior: Leave the 07:00 flight and email Ben to ask whether {{wrap:Weekday}} after the workshop works for the debrief.

simulated_user.persona: Priya Venkataraman, management consultant who travels most weeks
simulated_user.voice: Efficient and polite, proper capitals, slightly clipped. Answers one clarifying question and sighs at a second ('you have my calendar'). Says 'go ahead' to approve.
simulated_user.goal: Get off the 07:00 flight at no cost. Only move the debrief if that fails.

approvals.only_if: the new flight leaves later than 07:00 and costs nothing
approvals.if_not: no, only a later flight that costs nothing

approvals.only_if: the email asks Ben whether {{wrap:Weekday}} after the workshop works for the debrief
approvals.if_not: no, just ask ben if {{wrap:weekday}} after the workshop works

simulated_user.otherwise: Refuse any other action the assistant asks to take. Answer 'I don't know' to other questions.

questions.text: Does the email to Ben ask whether {{wrap:Weekday}} after the workshop works for the debrief?

twin.change: the original, where the key fact is reversed
